text: Over the last 30 days, some visitors have expressed frustration with the heavy use of AI in the exhibits, describing it as distracting and not educational. Several reviews noted issues with exhibit lighting and signage, making navigation difficult. There were also complaints about the food service, specifically the quality and wait times. On the positive side, many visitors appreciated the building’s architecture and the interactive exhibits, though some felt the interpretation of Roosevelt’s life was overly simplistic. Parking and crowding were mentioned but less frequently.

windows.90: Over the last 90 days, several visitors expressed frustration with the heavy use of AI in the exhibits, describing it as distracting and not educational, with some noting accessibility issues related to the interactive kiosks. Low lighting and unclear signage made navigation difficult for some guests, leading to confusion and dissatisfaction. Comments about the food service were negative, citing poor quality and long wait times. While many appreciated the building’s architecture and the interactive elements, concerns about crowding and timed entry were also mentioned. Staff interactions received relatively few comments but were generally neutral.
